subject: Language Arts
title: Words Build Stories
subtitle: Reading, Grammar, Writing, and the Power of Words
reading: Read and discuss today's assigned passage.
grammar: Identify nouns, verbs, and complete sentences.
writing: Write a short descriptive paragraph using complete sentences.
vocabulary: Identify unfamiliar words from today's reading.
handwriting: Complete a short copywork passage using careful penmanship.
skillFocus: Recognizing how strong word choices and complete sentences communicate ideas clearly.
theme: Good readers pay attention to words, and good writers choose their words carefully.
